<!-- Contributors do not publish to xlings-res; maintainers do, and later. Most packages should
point at the upstream's own release. This is for what the upstream cannot serve: a repack, a
layout fix, a static/musl build the upstream does not publish. -->

### Package and why it is generally useful | 包及其通用性

### The asset | 资产

- Source (URL and sha256) | 来源:
- If you built it: the exact reproducible process (commands, tool versions, inputs) and where it
  is hosted now | 若是自行构建：可复现的完整过程与当前托管位置:
- Platforms and architectures | 平台与架构:
